steps.description: Amend docs/adr/ADR-006-resume-contract.md: insert step 3.6 (rehydrate completed-stage artifacts before dispatch loop; absent artifact causes exit 1; ordering constraint: not to be combined with dispatch-loop changes) and add enforcing test names (resume-rehydrate-test.sh, resume-entry-points-test.sh) inline

Amend docs/adr/ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md §6: add boundary note that resume (same run, ADR-006) is distinct from new-run reuse (ADR-050 §6 governs); update §6's Enforced by entry to also cite resume-rehydrate-test.sh (new-run side: FRSH-2) and resume-entry-points-test.sh (resume side: ENTR-1) alongside the existing resume-default-test.sh R5–R11 citation
Add _artifact_persist_put_back <from> <to> to core/state/artifact-persist.sh (no-clobber copy skipping stage-io/); body identical to current _hydrate_put_back
Redirect plugins/tool/hydrate/plugin.sh hydrate_run call site (line 162) to _artifact_persist_put_back (hydrate already sources artifact-persist.sh)

Update tests/unit/hydrate-stage-test.sh: add [#1805/DLGT-1] section that overrides _artifact_persist_put_back with a sentinel-writing function, runs hydrate_run, and asserts the sentinel was written — fails when plugin reverted to inline _hydrate_put_back

Confirm _cycle_orchestrator_run_body in core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh: the `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` guard (wrapping `_persisted_iter` read; consuming flag immediately with `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=false`; else branch sets `_start_iter=1`) is already in place — verify it is present and correct

In runner.sh, confirm `export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true` is present immediately after the _runner_resume_rehydrate call (runner.sh:2862); do NOT set it for fresh runs; confirm `_cycle_dispatch` (runner.sh:3204) emits `stage.start` for `_cd_iter > 0` unconditionally — this is correct (the flag is consumed before the loop so a `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` guard here would suppress stage.start even during resume)

In runner.sh auto-resume elif branch (line 2174), extend state discovery: when `$state_dir/pipeline-state.json` does not exist and `$state_dir/latest` is a symlink to a directory containing `pipeline-state.json`, use `$state_dir/latest/pipeline-state.json` as the candidate state file; when `auto_resume` recommendation fires via this path, update state_dir to the resolved per-run directory (via readlink -f) and state_file to `$state_dir/pipeline-state.json`; ensures auto-resume works for the per-run default layout (ADR-059 §1) without requiring ZBUILD_STATE_FILE

Update tests/integration/resume-entry-points-test.sh: add [#1805/ENTR-2] sub-case that sets ZBUILD_STATE_ROOT to a temp directory, creates `$ZBUILD_STATE_ROOT/runs/<run_id>/pipeline-state.json` with status=interrupted and intake=complete, creates a `$ZBUILD_STATE_ROOT/latest` symlink pointing to that dir, invokes the runner with ZBUILD_STATE_FILE and ZBUILD_STATE_DIR unset, and asserts: pipeline.resume event emitted (auto-resume fired), completed-stage artifacts restored, no stage.start for intake

Update tests/integration/cycle-member-dispatch-events-test.sh to expect stage.start events for cycle members at iter > 0 (the `_cd_iter > 0` guard in `_cycle_dispatch` emits stage.start for all cycle member dispatches, fresh and resume); also confirm cycle-inner-iter-resets-per-outer-iter-test.sh, nested-loop-rounds-test.sh, and nested-loop-rounds-build-test.sh pass after the cycle-orchestrator ITER-1 guard fix

Update tests/integration/resume-loop-state-test.sh: (1) add `export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true` immediately before the cycle_orchestrator_run call so the [#1805/ITER-1] assertion "first dispatched iter is 2" reaches the guard; (2) add [#1805/CMBR-1] sub-case with a fixture where iter 1 fully completed and iter 2 ran build (complete) then was interrupted before test; set up persisted state accordingly; invoke the runner with --resume; assert no stage.start event for "build" in iter 2 and a stage.start event for "test" in iter 2

In `_cycle_dispatch` (runner.sh:~3204) and the cycle orchestrator body (cycle-orchestrator.sh), add a skip-on-complete guard for the first resumed iteration: the cycle orchestrator passes `resume_first_iter=true` only when dispatching members of `_start_iter` during a resume (i.e., `_start_iter > 1` and current iter == `_start_iter`); `_cycle_dispatch` with that flag checks the cycle member stage's status in persisted state and skips (no stage.start) any member already marked complete — this is the CMBR-1 fix (Gap 9)

Update tests/integration/resume-rehydrate-test.sh: (1) fix grep-c anti-pattern sites — replace with wc -l; (2) add --no-resume flag to the fresh-run sub-case; (3) remove stale cycled-dispatch assert_gt block; (4) retag the assert_contains type:cycle line to [#1805/CYCL-1]; (5) add [#1805/FRSH-1] assertion in the --no-resume sub-case verifying all stages dispatched from stage 1 with no stage.skip events emitted; (6) add [#1805/DSPK-1] assertion in the resume sub-case verifying stage k emits stage.start; (7) add [#1805/FRSH-2] assertion in a sub-case with prior run state present and no --resume flag, verifying no stages are skipped due to prior run output; (8) add [#1805/SKIP-1] assertion in the resume sub-case verifying no stage.start for a stage already marked complete whose artifact is present after rehydration

Update tests/integration/from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh: (1) fix FSTG-1 zero-count grep-c with wc -l; (2) retag assert_contains type:cycle to [#1805/CYCL-1]; (3) change FSTG-2 assert_contains to check for "has no restorable primary artifact"
Verify tests/integration/pipeline-resume-test.sh: intake's primary artifact pre-written to ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the --resume run

Verify tests/integration/resume-after-sigint-test.sh: mock_plugin_factory "intake" writes intake-result.json; runner snapshots it after Phase 1; resume rehydration restores it; P2.T1 (rc=0) still passes with RHYD-2 fail-closed in effect
Run npm test and confirm full suite green
